_comment: Turn-event tracking: read created_ephemeral_this_turn — private flag(s) nothing set. Attacks and token creation are now recorded by the engine and read via EVENT_THIS_TURN. 'Your next attack this turn gets +1{p}' was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues a one-shot and only needs to run when the card is played. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'the next time you would create a card with ephemeral this turn, instead create that many plus 1' is a REPLACEMENT on token creation. It was authored as an ON_TOKEN_CREATED trigger creating 2 more, which is an extra creation rather than a replaced one -- and gated on a condition that reads the very event it fires on. Removed rather than left creating tokens the card does not.
